newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares edge down at noon in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares edge down at noon in dull trade.

text.p: Shanghai B shares edged lower at midday on Tuesday on thin demand with most investors taking a wait-and-see attitude ahead of corporate interim results, brokers said.
The B index fell 0.257 point or 0.35 percent to 74.028 on thin volume of 2.31 million shares worth $1.105 million, compared with 3.681 million shares on Monday morning.
Some overseas investors were taking profits but selling interest was light, brokers said.
Brokers said recent sluggish trading hurt market sentiment and kept funds flowing out of the bourse.
"Investors have little interest in trading in an absence of market-moving news," one broker said. "Some foreign investors were seen cashing in their positions to move to other active markets."
"Downward potential will be limited, as trading volume is thin and many shares are already undervalued compared with their A share counterparts," another broker said.
Of 45 B share issues, 29 were traded, with 12 losing ground while 10 were higher and seven unchanged.
Inner Mongolia Erdos Cashmere Products was the morning's biggest loser on overseas institutional selling, sliding $0.038 or 4.76 percent to $0.760 on volume of 251,000 shares.

Hainan Airline was the most actively traded issue, falling $0.010 or 1.88 percent to $0.520 on volume of 416,000 shares. On Monday, it said it wanted to make a larger than expected A share offer of 100 to 150 million shares.
Shanghai's A share index staged a technical rebound from its sharp losses over the past few trading days, but volume did not expand as sentiment remained cautious, brokers said.
The A share index rose 12.121 points or 1.02 percent to 1,205.518 on volume of 132.7 million shares worth 1.3 billion yuan.
The SSE30 blue chip index gained 44.344 points or 1.23 percent to 3,640.783 points.
Shanghai Petrochemical was the biggest gainer, rising on institutional support. It added 0.30 yuan or 7.28 percent to 4.42 yuan on volume of 15.3 million shares.
